title: Raw triangle pullback commutes with etale restriction
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, schemes Y, Y′, S, morphisms a:Y′→Y, h:Y→S, h′:Y′→S with a≫h=h′, bounded-below derived module sheaves K on Y and K′ on Y′, integer q, and a specified derived coefficient morphism v:a* K→K′ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], define r_U(z) by the single-complex map of the pullback composition isomorphism, the inverse single-complex comparison, derived pullback of z, the shift comparison, and v[q] [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. For etale S-objects T,U, b:T→U and a raw class z∈Hom(h*Λ[U][0],K[q]), one has r_T(z|_T)=r_U(z)|_T.

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1, canonical comparison maps; explicit derived-Hom formulation

proof.text: Restriction is precomposition with the single-complex free-sheaf map. Apply naturality of inverse-image composition and of the inverse single-complex comparison to this map, then functoriality of derived pullback. Postcompose by the fixed shift comparison and v[q]; associativity gives the claimed equality.
